challenges.title: Hello World Component
challenges.description:
Create a function component named `HelloWorld` that renders a single `

` with the text 'Hello, World!'. App must render HelloWorld.

challenges.title: Display Your Name
challenges.description: Create a component named `NameTag`. It must render a `<div>` containing an `<h2>` with the text 'My name is: ' followed by your name stored in a `const name` variable using a JSX expression.

challenges.title: Unordered List
challenges.description: Create a component named `FruitList` that renders a `<ul>` with exactly three `<li>` elements: 'Apple', 'Banana', and 'Cherry'. App must render FruitList.

challenges.title: Simple Button Click
challenges.description: Create a component `ClickMe` with a `<button>` that shows an alert saying 'Button clicked!' when clicked. The button text must be 'Click Me'.

requirements.text: Button must alert 'Button clicked!' when clicked.

challenges.title: Image with Alt Text
challenges.description: Create a component `Avatar` that renders an `` tag with `src="https://i.pravatar.cc/150"`, `alt="User Avatar"`, and `width="150"`.

challenges.title: Boolean Prop Toggle Display
challenges.description:
Create a component `Visibility` that accepts a `show` boolean prop. If `show` is true, render a `

` with 'Visible'. If `show` is false, render a `

` with 'Hidden'. Use a ternary operator.

challenges.title: Render a Number List with .map()
challenges.description: Create a component `NumberList` that renders an ordered list `<ol>` from the array `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` using `.map()`. Each `<li>` should display the number. Remember to add a unique `key` prop to each `<li>`.

requirements.text: Each <li> must have a key prop.

challenges.title: Toggle Dark/Light Mode
challenges.description: Create a `ThemeToggle` component. Use `useState` to track a boolean `isDark` (initial: false). Render a `<div>` with `className` toggled between `'theme-dark'` and `'theme-light'` based on `isDark`. Inside it, show a `<button>` that toggles the theme. Button text: 'Switch to Dark' when light, 'Switch to Light' when dark.

requirements.text: className must toggle between theme-dark and theme-light.
Button text must change based on current theme.

challenges.title: Controlled Input
challenges.description:
Create a `NameInput` component. Use `useState` to store a `name` string (initial: ''). Render a `` that updates the state on every keystroke (`onChange`). Below the input, show a `

` that displays 'Hello, {name}!' — it should update live as the user types.

challenges.title: Props-based Greeting Card
challenges.description:
Create a `GreetingCard` component that accepts `name` (string), `role` (string), and `age` (number) props via **destructuring**. Display them in a styled card: - `

` showing the name - `

` showing the role - `` showing 'Age: {age}' App renders ``.

requirements.text: Must render an h2 with the name.

challenges.title: Todo List (Add Items)
challenges.description:
Create a `TodoList` component with:
1. `useState` for `todos` (initial: empty array) and `input` (initial: '').
2. A controlled `<input>` bound to `input` state.
3. An 'Add' `<button>` that appends the input value to `todos` and clears the input.
4. Render the list as a `<ul>` with each todo in a `<li>` (use index as key).

requirements.text: Must use useState for todos and input.
Add button must append item to list.

challenges.title: Star Rating Display
challenges.description: Create a `StarRating` component that accepts a `rating` prop (number 1–5). Render 5 `<span>` elements. Filled stars (★) for indexes ≤ rating, empty stars (☆) for the rest. Each span has class `star-filled` or `star-empty`. App renders `<StarRating rating={3} />`.

requirements.text: Filled stars must use class star-filled.
Empty stars must use class star-empty.

challenges.title: Password Visibility Toggle
challenges.description: Create a `PasswordInput` component. Use `useState` for `visible` (initial: false). Render an `<input>` whose `type` switches between `'password'` and `'text'` based on `visible`. Render a `<button>` that toggles `visible`; button text: 'Show' or 'Hide'.

requirements.text: Input type must toggle between text and password.
Button text must toggle between Show and Hide.

challenges.title: Tabs Component
challenges.description: Create a `Tabs` component with 3 tabs: 'Home', 'Profile', 'Settings'. Use `useState` for `activeTab` (initial: 'Home'). Render 3 `<button>` elements. The active button gets `className='tab-active'`, others get `className='tab'`. Below the buttons, render a `<div className='tab-content'>` showing 'You are on the {activeTab} tab.'

requirements.text: Active button must have class tab-active.
Tab content must update when a tab is clicked.

challenges.title: Shopping Cart with Total
challenges.description:
Build a `ShoppingCart` component with these items pre-loaded in state: `[{id:1,name:'Apple',price:1.5,qty:1},{id:2,name:'Bread',price:2.0,qty:1},{id:3,name:'Milk',price:3.5,qty:1}]` For each item show the name, price, and two buttons `+` / `−` to adjust qty (minimum 1). Show a `

` with `Total: $X.XX` that updates live. Use `className='cart-wrap'` on the container.

requirements.text: + button must increase qty and update total.
− button must not allow qty below 1.
Total must update live and be formatted as $X.XX.

challenges.title: Accordion / FAQ
challenges.description:
Build an `Accordion` component. Use this data (hardcoded):
```
[
  {id:1, q:'What is React?', a:'A JavaScript library for building UIs.'},
  {id:2, q:'What is JSX?', a:'A syntax extension for JavaScript.'},
  {id:3, q:'What is useState?', a:'A hook to add state to function components.'}
]
```
For each item render a `<button>` (the question) and a `<div className='answer'>` visible only when that item is expanded. Clicking the button toggles it open/closed. Only **one item** can be open at a time. Use `className='accordion-wrap'` on the container.

requirements.text: Must use useState to track the open item.
Answers must be hidden by default.
Clicking a question must reveal its answer.
Only one item can be open at a time.

challenges.title: Search & Filter List
challenges.description:
Build a `SearchList` component. Start with a hardcoded list of 6 countries: `['Vietnam','Japan','France','Brazil','Germany','Canada']`. Use `useState` for a `query` string (initial ''). Render a controlled `` for the search. Below it render a `
    ` showing only countries that **include** the query (case-insensitive). Show `'No results found.'` in a `

    ` if nothing matches.

requirements.text: Must show 'No results found.' when list is empty.
Input must be a controlled component.

challenges.title: Multi-step Form Wizard
challenges.description:
Build a `FormWizard` component with 3 steps:
- Step 1: `<input>` for Name, 'Next' button
- Step 2: `<input>` for Email, 'Back' + 'Next' buttons
- Step 3: Summary showing entered Name and Email, 'Back' + 'Submit' button (Submit alerts 'Form submitted!')
Use `useState` for `step` (1–3), `name`, and `email`. Show only the current step. Show a progress indicator `'Step {step} of 3'` at the top using `className='progress'`.

requirements.text: Must use useState for step, name, and email.
Must show Step {step} of 3 progress indicator.
Next and Back must navigate between steps correctly.

challenges.title: Countdown Timer
challenges.description: Build a `CountdownTimer` component. Use `useState` for `seconds` (initial: 10) and `running` (initial: false). Use `useEffect` to set up an interval when `running` is true that decreases `seconds` by 1 every second. When `seconds` reaches 0, stop the timer. Render: the countdown in a large `<h1>`, a 'Start' / 'Pause' button (toggles running), and a 'Reset' button that sets seconds back to 10 and stops the timer. Wrap in `className='timer-wrap'`.

requirements.text: Must use useState for seconds and running.
Must use useEffect to drive the interval.
Timer must stop when seconds reaches 0.
Reset must restore seconds to 10 and stop the timer.

challenges.title: Kanban Board (3 Columns)
challenges.description: Build a `KanbanBoard` with 3 columns: 'Todo', 'In Progress', 'Done'. Initial state: `{ Todo: ['Write tests','Fix bug'], 'In Progress': ['Build UI'], Done: ['Setup repo'] }`. Each card in a column has a '→' button that moves it to the next column (Todo→In Progress→Done; Done cards have no button). Render columns with `className='col'` and cards with `className='card'`. Column headers in `<h4>`.

requirements.text: Must use useState for board state.
→ button must move card to the next column.
Done column cards must not have a → button.
Board must have 3 columns with correct headers.
